reason: The i386 corpus exercises x87 stack instructions whose exact register-stack and status effects are not yet represented for every encoding in LLIR.
semantic_risk: Maximal opaque effects preserve soundness but sever floating-point value and stack dataflow, reducing recovered expressions and prototypes.
removal_condition: Remove or narrow this family when every observed x87 mnemonic has an exact typed footprint and the measured opaque count falls.

reason: HLT is a privileged stop instruction and currently has no dedicated terminal LLIR operation.
semantic_risk: Treating HLT as a maximal opaque effect can obscure termination and blocks dataflow across padding or privileged code.
removal_condition: Remove when HLT lowers to an explicit non-fallthrough system or trap operation.

reason: PAUSE is an execution hint and the current LLIR has no explicit hint operation carrying its non-memory footprint.
semantic_risk: The opaque form invents maximal memory effects and can inhibit loop and value simplification.
removal_condition: Remove when PAUSE lowers to a reviewed hint or no-op representation with exact effects.

reason: UD2 intentionally traps and currently has no dedicated non-returning trap operation in LLIR.
semantic_risk: The opaque form does not state non-returning control flow, which can retain unreachable paths and degrade structuring.
removal_condition: Remove when UD2 lowers to an explicit non-returning trap operation.

reason: ARM predication cannot yet express every conditional control effect without a first-class guarded terminator.
semantic_risk: The maximal effect is sound but loses the guarded control-flow fact and may block value propagation and structuring.
removal_condition: Remove when every observed predicated control instruction lowers to an exact guarded control-flow representation.

reason: SVC crosses an operating-system ABI boundary whose register and memory effects are not established from the instruction alone.
semantic_risk: Maximal effects are sound but erase syscall argument and result dataflow when the surrounding platform ABI is knowable.
removal_condition: Remove or specialize when TargetSpec exposes a platform syscall contract and SVC is annotated through it.
